caption:
What's in your fridge right now? Comment 3 things.

At 6 pm, instead of running to the shop, ask eNZi “what can I make with what I have?” or tap “From the Pantry”. You get a dinner idea from what's already at home, and your meal plan starts from the fridge; you choose.

WE.LIFE is a Life OS for everyday life, and Food OS is its first module. The link to the free WE.LIFE beta is in our bio @welife.world. This is a beta (test) version.

Images in this video are AI-generated illustrations.

#dinnerideas #foodwaste #mealplan
